title: [SEC6] Good: cannotCalculateChanges fallback in event handler
description:
In app.js handleStateEvent() (lines 546-551), when Message/changes returns 'cannotCalculateChanges' (indicating a state gap), the code falls back to re-fetching all messages for the current chat.

This is correct defensive programming. State gaps can occur if:
- The client was offline too long and missed intermediate state tokens
- The server garbage-collected old state tokens
- Time skew or clock rollback occurred

Rather than guessing or silently dropping messages, the code resyncs the entire thread. Same pattern applied to Chat/changes (lines 573-575).

Alternative (ignore the error or just update from latest state) would leave messages out of the UI. Re-fetch is safe and complete.
